title: Decision
description: The contract between BarelySmash intelligence engines and every downstream consumer. Specified in architecture/decision-object.md.

schema_version.description: Semver of the Decision specification this object conforms to.

decision_id.description: Globally unique identifier. 'dec_' followed by a 26-character ULID.

source.description: The engine that produced this Decision. JARVIS is never a valid source.

source_version.description: Semver of the engine build that produced this Decision. Required for reproducibility.

domain.description: Subdomain inside the engine that reasoned about this. Lowercase snake_case.

category.description: Engine-namespaced decision category. Registry lives in glossary/.

priority.description: Cost of acting late. Not magnitude of impact.

confidence.description: Estimated probability that the underlying insight holds. 0.30 is the emission floor.

summary.description: One imperative sentence. Lands verbatim in the Executive Brief.

rationale.description: Two to four sentences connecting evidence to recommendation. Expected for critical and high priority.

evidence.description: The Observations supporting this Decision. A Decision with no evidence is an opinion.

derived_from.description: The Insights this Decision rests on. Optional; see adr/0004-insight-as-a-contract.md.

requires_approval.description: Whether a human must approve before any Action executes. Defaults to true.

supersedes.description: The decision_id this Decision replaces. Must share source and category.

tags.description: Free-form filtering labels. Nothing may depend on a tag for correctness.

created_at.description: When the engine emitted this Decision. RFC 3339, UTC, Z suffix.

expires_at.description: When this Decision stops being actionable. Must be later than created_at.

observation_id.description: Trace back to the Observation record. 'obs_' followed by a 26-character ULID.

statement.description: The observation in plain language. Factual, no interpretation.

source_ref.description: Pointer to the underlying record, report, or dataset.

metric.description: Structured form of an observation, so applications can chart what JARVIS narrates.

delta.description: Change over the stated period, as a fraction. 0.12 is a 12% increase.

period.description: ISO 8601 duration the metric covers, e.g. P4W, P1D, PT1H.

action_type.description: Names an executable Action the application supports. Absent means advisory only.

reversible.description: Whether the Action can be undone. Defaults to false deliberately.

horizon.description: ISO 8601 duration over which the impact is expected.
